7.2.2 Technical Overview
UCM Master
objective is to provide a standard Adaptive Autosar solution to safely and
securely update a complete vehicle Over The Air or by a Diagnostic Tester.
UCM Master
receives packages from
Backend
or Diagnostic tool, parses and inter-
prets the
Vehicle Package
, transfers or streams
Software Packages
to suitable
targets (
UCM
subordinate or Diagnostic Application) and orchestrates the processing,
activations and eventual rollbacks. All these actions are what is called a campaign
which
UCM Master
is coordinating. The
UCM
of the machines in the same network of
a
UCM Master
, candidates target of a campaign, are referred to as
UCM
subordinates.
